name: Requestly
summary: Requestly is an API client with collections, environments, a collection runner and scheduled cloud runs. Team costs $10 and Team Pro $15 per user a month, billed annually. The pricing page lists no free plan, but it has a 30-day trial with no credit card.

facts.text: The collection runner has a Run in CLI tab that generates pipeline files for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins and Azure Pipelines.
A Scheduled tab in the runner runs a collection automatically on a recurring schedule.
Variables are scoped at global, runtime, environment and collection level, and the docs include a variable precedence page.
The Team plan lists unlimited manual collection runs, unlimited automated cloud runs, a CLI runner and data-driven testing.
A 30-day trial with full Team Pro features is offered on the pricing page, which says 'no credit card required'.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually, $600 a year for 5 users; the page shows no monthly-billing price. Sold in seat tiers of 5, 10, 15, 20 and more than 20. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Team Pro
plans.notes: Billed annually, $900 a year for 5 users; the page shows no monthly-billing price. Adds AI features, secret scanning, external vault integrations and advanced test reporting

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales; annual only and an add-on to Team or Team Pro. Adds single sign-on, SCIM, audit logs and data residency or self-hosting
